title: Re-review Input Manifest (hash-bound, freshness-checked)
description: Emitted by the dispatching layer BEFORE Phase 1 of the #576 Spec B three-gate re-review contract. Every gate input is a present-DISCRIMINATED union — an absent artifact carries NO ref, hash, or freshness fields (no sentinel strings, no fabricated hashes); the §11 presence policies decide what each absence means. Its JSON-Canonical-Form sha256 rides in every phase artifact (input_manifest_hash -> precommitment_hash -> verdict_record_hash chain), so scripts/check_re_review_synthesis.py can prove all three gates saw the same inputs. Spec: docs/design/2026-07-27-576-spec-b-re-review-precommitment-contract-spec.md §11.

cross_model_active.description: The dispatching layer's configuration declaration at emission — the checker input for every configuration-dependent rule (e.g. single_family_disclosed validity). Consistency-checked against the sidecar: any row with cross_model_status in {agree, diverges, unavailable} (only not_configured is neutral), any RebuttalAdjudication, any judge-shortcut record, or any booked_disclosed disposition implies true.

revision_patches.description: By-position pair of apply_reports; when both arrays are present their lengths MUST be equal, and each apply report's patch_digest must equal the paired entry's sha256 (content-bound pairing, §11).

apply_reports.description: present: false IS the canonical empty encoding (zero reports <=> the witness's not_run_no_reports — one fact, one encoding). apply_reports present with revision_patches absent or length-mismatched -> manifest_incomplete, G0.

artifact_ref.description: TAGGED union with closed grammar passport:<artifact_ref> | path:<relative path> — the prefix IS the passport-tracked discriminator; no untagged strings. The path form is RELATIVE only: no leading separator, no drive letter, no '..' traversal segments (checker-mirrored).

freshness_value.description: Copied from the artifact's Material Passport entry when the ref is passport:-tagged, else null. A null on a passport: entry fails the checker; null on a path: entry is a visible degradation (freshness rules skip it).

items.description: Every element FULLY populated (no per-element absence). The array discriminates at the ARRAY level.
